visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair and black-framed glasses wearing a white t-shirt and a dark blue cardigan stands in a well-lit, modern kitchen with white cabinetry and wooden shelves. She looks directly at the camera with an expressive face, opening her mouth wide as if speaking enthusiastically. White text captions appear in the lower center. (2) Close-up of the woman's hands holding a large salmon rice ball wrapped in seaweed. Four miniature versions of her are edited into the frame, posing around the rice ball. The setting remains the blurred kitchen background. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of two salmon steaks on a metal tray lined with parchment paper. A hand shakes a large, light-colored wooden salt shaker over the fish. Yellow and white captions appear. (4) The woman, now in a pink shirt, carries the tray across the kitchen. The environment is bright with natural light from the side. She then pours a bag of 'Sea Bream Broth Salt' onto a small grey plate; a miniature version of her stands on the pile of salt. (5) In a white ceramic pot, white rice is being seasoned with the broth salt. The woman's hands use a wooden spatula to stir the rice. A miniature version of her is seen clinging to the spatula as it moves through the rice. (6) Two salmon steaks are placed in a black cast iron pan over a blue gas flame. A liquid is poured from a glass bowl onto the fish. A lid is placed on top, and steam rises. A miniature figure of the woman lies on the lid. (7) Cooked salmon is flaked on a grey plate using two metal forks. The woman then forms rice balls by hand, placing a portion of salmon inside. She wraps them in plastic wrap to shape them. (8) In a light-colored frying pan, the rice balls are grilled. A dark miso sauce is brushed onto one side using a silicone brush. The rice ball is flipped, showing a golden-brown charred crust. A miniature woman sits on the edge of the pan. (9) Finally, a grilled rice ball is placed in a white bowl. Broth is poured over it from a white pot. Toppings like green onions and flaked salmon are added. The woman is shown eating the rice ball with a satisfied expression.
